assets.brief: 2人目の主人公（中性的なマッシュの少年魔法剣士）のデザイン候補4案を1枚に並べる
assets.prompt:
A character design lineup sheet showing FOUR candidate designs for ONE original hero: an androgynous teenage boy mage (about 15-17 years old, slim, gentle and slightly mysterious, could almost be mistaken for a girl but is a boy) with a neat rounded MUSHROOM-CUT bob hairstyle (thick rounded fringe falling to the eyebrows, hair rounded around the head to the ears or jaw), calm half-lidded eyes with a cool glint, and a small confident smile. He is a magic swordsman who gathers floating blue mana orbs and releases them through a blade. Every candidate has 3 to 5 small glowing pale-blue mana orbs floating around him. Arrange the four candidates side by side in one horizontal row, evenly spaced with clear empty space between them, each a full-body front three-quarter view standing on the same ground line at the same height, facing slightly RIGHT, so the outfit and weapon shape are clearly readable. Keep the same boy, face type and mushroom-cut hair concept in all four, but vary hair color, outfit and weapon so each has a distinctly different silhouette:
(1) LEFT: navy-black mushroom-cut hair with a sapphire sheen; a long high-collared navy mage coat with silver clasps and wide sleeves; a silver vambrace on his right forearm that projects a straight blade made of pale-blue light.
(2) CENTER-LEFT: silver-white mushroom-cut hair; a short white-and-sapphire hooded cape worn with the hood DOWN, shorts and tall boots; a slim staff whose tip is a crystal blade, like a sword-staff.
(3) CENTER-RIGHT: ice-blue mushroom-cut hair; a layered sapphire robe with a wide sash and loose sleeves; three translucent ice-crystal short swords orbiting behind his shoulders instead of a held weapon.
(4) RIGHT: dark-blue mushroom-cut hair with lighter tips; a fitted navy academy jacket with a short shoulder cape and a book chained at his hip; a thin rapier held low, its blade etched with glowing blue runes.
All four share the same painted style, line weight, lighting and palette, and all show their faces clearly (no masks, no hoods over the face). Plain flat light-grey background, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadows, no frames, no dividers, no labels or numbers.

His hair is a neat rounded MUSHROOM-CUT bob in navy-black with a sapphire sheen, thick fringe falling to the eyebrows. He wears a long high-collared navy (#1B2A55) mage coat reaching his shins, with wide bell sleeves lined in lighter blue, a row of ornate silver clasps down the chest, silver-trimmed hems and silver diamond ornaments, a white tassel and a small glowing blue orb hanging from the belt at the front; black trousers and tall black boots with silver plates. On his RIGHT forearm he wears an ornate silver vambrace that projects a long straight blade made of pale-blue (#7FD3FF) light, pointing down and forward; his LEFT hand is raised palm-up with three glowing pale-blue mana orbs floating above it. Three-quarter view turned toward the RIGHT, standing calmly with feet planted. Show every identifying detail clearly: the mushroom-cut hair, the high collar, the silver clasps, both sleeves, the vambrace and light blade, the mana orbs, the belt tassel and orb, and the boots. Complete figure from the top of his hair to his boot soles and the blade tip, with at least 6 percent transparent margin on every side. No scenery, floor, shadow, border or text. This image is the canonical design reference for all other assets of this hero.
